punchline: A bullet bounced off a wedding ring, and Elrod says that is exactly the kind of miracle you should not wait for.
thirty_sec: Donnie Register was working in an antique store when someone was about to shoot him. He threw his hands up to his face and the bullet bounced off his gold wedding ring. Hal Elrod calls that a passive miracle: nobody can explain it or plan it. His book is about the other kind, created miracles, which people make through belief and hard work. He calls the ones who go after them Miracle Mavens.
